rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a boast or boastful talk, especially an exaggerated claim.

example.english: He likes to brag, making himself sound like he knows everything.
example.traditional: 佢成日吹牛，講到自己好似乜都識咁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ceoi1 ngau4 gong2 dou3 zi6 gei2 hou2 ci5 mat1 dou1 sik1 gam3
